# Pixel Switchboard

A simple offline browser app with 8 labelled switches and matching lamps. Each switch toggles its lamp on or off. Includes "All on" and "All off" buttons, and a counter showing how many lamps are on.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- 8 switches (numbered 1–8) with corresponding lamps
- Click a switch to toggle its lamp
- "All on" and "All off" buttons for quick control
- Live counter of lamps that are on
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Cohesive dark theme with pixel-style controls

## Files

- `index.html` — main page structure
- `styles.css` — styling and layout
- `script.js` — interactive logic

## Constraints

- No external dependencies, network requests, or inline event handlers
- Uses only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript
- Graphics drawn with CSS
- Uses `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` for hidden elements (none currently used)
